key_risks: Raw Material Risk: Fluctuations in aluminium prices and availability of imported raw materials may impact production costs and profitability.
Foreign Exchange Risk: Dependence on imported materials exposes the Company to currency fluctuations.
Technology Risk: Continuous technological developments require ongoing investments in product development, manufacturing processes and quality improvements.
Market Risk: Demand fluctuations in end-user industries, pricing pressure and competitive intensity may affect business performance.
Operational Risk: Risks associated with equipment reliability, utilities, skilled manpower availability and production continuity.
Regulatory Risk: Changes in taxation, environmental regulations, import-export policies and other statutory requirements may influence business operations.
Cyber Security Risk: Growing digitalization necessitates stronger information security systems to safeguard business information and operational continuity.
